long_biography.plain_text:
Before becoming a broadcasting executive, James Murdoch helped establish Rawkus, a New York hip-hop label, with two friends. He had left Harvard after working on student journalism and cartoons. When News Corporation bought the label, he joined the family company. He went on to work on its music and internet businesses.

His philanthropic work has also centred on how information reaches people. With his wife, Kathryn, he founded Quadrivium, which supports scientific understanding, climate and ocean health, and democratic participation. The foundation has backed the American Journalism Project, helping nonprofit local news organisations strengthen their business operations and reach more communities.
